name: Project Rebound at California State University – Fresno
description: Supports the success of formerly incarcerated students by offering resources needed to successfully transition and acclimate to a college campus. Services provided include support through student orientation, enrollment process, financial aid process and academic planning.
address: 2576 E. San Ramon St., Soc. Science Rm. 106, Fresno, CA 93740

name: Rising Scholars at Fresno City College
description: The Rising Scholars Program is funded by the Formerly Incarcerated Students Reentry Program Grant. The program is designed to establish or support formerly incarcerated students enrolled in community college and focuses on the students' successful reentry into the community. Services provided include peer mentor support, activities designed for formerly incarcerated student success, academic counseling, tutoring, and resource connections.
who_it_serves: Explicitly serves people on parole/probation or returning from incarceration (per program description)
